meta.name: Japani Toy
meta.description: What happens when you want to open a sex toy shop in Kolkata? Dildo Kumar has a gift for the lonely people of Kolkata - a Japani doll. No commitment, no emotion: just pure, unlimited fun!

videos.title: Khatarnak Darinda
videos.overview: Things go unexpected when Delhi-based Joy is coaxed by his friends to visit a brothel. Little does he know, that this will be a lifetime experience for him.

videos.title: Eureka
videos.overview: A jobless Joy decides to leave for Kolkata, and start life afresh, but this time with his own unique start up: the first ever sex toy shop in town!

videos.title: No guilt, no shame
videos.overview: While the local councillor unknowingly gives Joy a shop space, his fiance Kinkini and her family are infuriated with his idea! Is Joy still determined?

videos.title: Sexy Siren
videos.overview: Joy has to win over Kinkini's love, but also has to make both ends meet about 'Sexy Siren', his sex toy shop. Will fate favour him?

videos.title: Shashikala Bylane
videos.overview: Joy is excited about getting his idea officially registered. On the other hand, councillor Gobordhon decides to back out after knowing Joy's business ventures.

videos.title: Vote for Dildo Kumar
videos.overview: Joy is upset as everyone is judging him but not questioning Gobordhon, who had earlier allowed businessmen to sell liquor, near a school locality.

videos.title: Home Delivery
videos.overview: A disheartened Joy decides to back out from his plans without knowing, what awaits him in the distant future.

videos.title: Japan Pherot
videos.overview: Joy is ready for two big events in his life - his marriage with Kinkini and his new business deal involving Japani dolls to Kolkata. Will things go as planned?

videos.title: Court Room e Kelenkari
videos.overview: Joy thinks that he has a revolutionary idea to control the country's population. But will his plan to sell Japani dolls in Kolkata land him in trouble?

videos.title: Balish Niye Nalish
videos.overview: Joy and Dalal start a rebellion inside the prison, and demand for bolster pillows for the lonely inmates. Whom will they join hands with for this?

videos.title: Jail Palano
videos.overview: Joy and his friends pick choose a unique method of rebelling, and put the officials in a fix. Meanwhile, will Kinkini's decision change Joy's life?

videos.title: Doll-A-Dolly
videos.overview: Joy finally tells his parents about his business plan of opening a shop called "Doll-A-Doli". But is he hiding an important piece of information?

videos.title: Handle with Care
videos.overview: Just as Joy starts getting praised by his father, his doll causes a sad incident in his family. But why does Kinkini want a Japani doll?

videos.title: Mission Kabul
videos.overview: A heart-broken Joy wants to go away to the Everest, but his Japanese business partners want him to go to Kabul. Can Kinkini stop him?
